title: feat(@angular/build): migrate Angular Linker to oxc-parser and magic-string

target.summary: OxcAstHost does not unwrap ParenthesizedExpression AST nodes across its AST query and parsing helper methods. When declaration metadata contains parenthesized expressions, such as arrow functions returning an object literal (() => ({ ... })), the linker fails to recognise expected AST node types and throws a FatalLinkerError.
notes: definition of OxcAstHost which fails to unwrap ParenthesizedExpression AST nodes
returns function body directly without unwrapping ParenthesizedExpression
call site using SHARED_AST_HOST to inspect and link partial declarations
